name: 扁平几何图标
description: 有限色板、粗几何、严格栅格。一致性可以用规则量化，最适合搭建自动打分与评测集，也是成套图标素材包里最好卖的一类。第一套跑通后启用。

blocks.en: flat vector icon, bold geometric shapes, swiss international style, single concept
strict four-color palette of brick red, mustard yellow, lake blue and charcoal on off-white, no additional colors
only circles, squares and rounded rectangles, uniform stroke weight, no outlines, no gradients
centered on a strict square grid, generous even padding, perfect optical balance, single focal point
perfectly flat solid fills, matte, no shadow, no texture, no bevel, no 3D depth
clean uniform off-white background, full bleed, nothing else in frame

subject: a coffee cup
a paper plane
a growing sprout
a padlock
a cloud with a sync arrow
a book with a bookmark
a compass
a lightbulb
asset_kind: a set of four aligned icons on one sheet

negative: photorealism, gradient, drop shadow, texture, 3D render, isometric, sketch, handwriting, text, letters, watermark, logo, human face, celebrity, cluttered composition
notes: 这一套的重点是可量化：eval_rules 用来给最终提示词打完整度分，配合批量生成做一致性评测。等风格 1 稳定后再切换为 active。
